title: CIELingo real-time unresolved word protocol
summary: Collects unknown words in real time, appends unresolved events, creates 0.5-confidence candidate cards only when local source evidence exists, and rolls up unresolved words daily.

protocol_contract.realtime: unknown tokens are appended immediately to unresolved streams
protocol_contract.daily: daily rollup summarizes unresolved words without deleting raw events
protocol_contract.canonization: forbidden automatically; review and evidence gate required
protocol_contract.source_policy: local evidence extracts only; no network fetch; license hint required
protocol_contract.number_policy: card order and filename numbers are technical identifiers only

word_field_contract.potential: semantic rest mass seed times ln(2)/(24pi)

epistemic_boundary: This is a local unresolved/candidate-card protocol, not external NOEMA SoT writeback, live Mongo write, or verified dictionary import.
description: Protokół nierozwiązanych słów CIELingo w czasie rzeczywistym
